remarks:
Welcome to an outstanding opportunity to restore a classic Craftsman-style brick home in the City of Niagara Falls. Offering 3 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom, this home is full of original character, including beautiful interior and exterior trim that can be brought back to its former charm. With solid bones and timeless architectural details, this property presents an excellent foundation for a thoughtful renovation.

The property is in need of renovation and is priced with its renovation needs in mind, making it an excellent opportunity for a new homeowner or investor looking to add value and build long-term equity.

This property is being offered for sale by the Niagara Orleans Regional Land Improvement Corporation (NORLIC). All offers must include a development plan addressed to NORLIC outlining the purchaser's relevant experience, proposed scope of work, estimated project costs, and anticipated timeline for completion. A development enforcement mortgage will be required, and the project will be monitored by NORLIC until the approved rehabilitation is complete.
